name: Read held citer pages before paying for cited-by
when: an anchor is resolved and the archive already holds its forward citations
shape: serve the archive's first citer page uncharged for the top anchors at execution start; pay for live cited-by only for anchors the archive lacks or where recency matters
ingredients: an archive of forward-citation pages with freshness
yields: hundreds of uncharged rows at query one (400 on EIC run 4); cb50 citer recall .235 → .995 on a citation-first run (EIC run 5)
misses: citers newer than the archive's harvest; anchors with thin holdings (served 1 of 21 walks on a Referee-thin topic)
origin: gs_revamp PR #184 archive-citer pass (2026-08-27); runs 4-5 measurements
